description: This file defines the UserEntity class, a JPA entity representing users in the banking core system, with fields for user details and a relationship to bank accounts.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: A JPA entity class representing a user in the system with personal details and associated bank accounts.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Getter for the user's ID (generated value).

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Getter for the user's first name.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Setter for the user's first name.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Getter for the user's last name.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Setter for the user's last name.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Getter for the user's email address.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Setter for the user's email address.

methods.name: getIdentificationNumber
methods.description: Getter for the user's identification number.

methods.name: setIdentificationNumber
methods.description: Setter for the user's identification number.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Getter for list of associated bank accounts.

methods.name: setAccounts
methods.description: Setter for list of associated bank accounts.
